title: VALORANT Champions Shanghai 2026 Enters Crucial Finals Weekend
body:
The 2026 VALORANT Champions tournament is approaching its conclusion in Shanghai, China, with the finals weekend scheduled for October 16–18. Sixteen teams entered the tournament to compete for the world championship and a share of the US$2.25 million prize pool.

Team Vitality and LOUD are scheduled to meet in the upper-bracket final on October 16, while 100 Thieves face G2 Esports in the lower bracket. The lower-bracket final follows on October 17, with the grand final scheduled for October 18.

The tournament brings together leading teams from the Americas, EMEA, Pacific and China regions. Fans are now watching closely to see which team can maintain its form under pressure and claim the world championship.
summary: VALORANT Champions Shanghai heads into finals weekend
